description: Auto-incrementing primary key — set by Postgres; never supplied by the caller.
Either "approve" (releases figures) or "revoke" (re-gates figures). Set by which button the manager clicks.
Unfiltered period identifier e.g. "2026-04-01_2027-03-31___". Derived from the period selector; filters (plant/machine) are stripped so a sign-off covers the full dataset.
Period start date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD) e.g. "2026-04-01". Derived from the period selector.
Period end date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD) e.g. "2027-03-31". Derived from the period selector.
Human-readable period name e.g. "Current FY" or "Apr 2026". Derived from the period selector.

SHA-256 (first 16 hex chars) of the sorted issue identities + confirmation status at the moment of sign-off. Changes automatically if the underlying sheet data changes, which re-gates the figures and invalidates this sign-off.
Confirmation status at the time of sign-off: "pass" / "warning" / "error". Taken from the live confirmation result.
Confirmation score label at the time of sign-off e.g. "4/4 files". Taken from the live confirmation result.
Number of error-severity issues at the time of sign-off. Taken from the live confirmation result.
Number of warning-severity issues at the time of sign-off. Taken from the live confirmation result.
Total issue count (errors + warnings) at the time of sign-off. Taken from the live confirmation result.
Name of the manager signing off. Typed into the "Your name" field on the Confirmation screen. Cannot be blank.
Job title or role of the approver e.g. "Plant Head". Typed into the "Role / designation" field. Left blank if not entered.
Free-text rationale or comment e.g. "Reviewed gaps — FY still in progress". Typed into the "Note (optional)" field. Left blank if not entered.
Timestamp (with time zone) when the row was inserted. Set automatically by Postgres DEFAULT now(); never supplied by the caller.
